basics.tagline: I build secure, scalable cloud platforms on Azure and AI agents that make engineering teams faster.
basics.summary: Software Engineer II at Microsoft with 3+ years building production Azure and AI systems in C#/.NET, Python, and TypeScript. Owned a greenfield AI platform's architecture; shipped agentic workflows, RAG, and multi-tenant services, saving an estimated 260+ engineering hours and doubling monthly users of a Microsoft 365 Lighthouse feature.

groups.name: AI-powered content authoring and content-health dashboard

bullets.text: Shipped one-click accuracy reviews that generated 250+ article pull requests in 3 weeks (~170 merged): APIs rank support articles due for review by page views and open a reviewable PR in ~2–4 s via a GitHub App.

Owned the greenfield platform's Azure architecture (Container Apps, Entra ID, Azure Data Explorer): repo strategy, a layered Backend-for-Frontend design, and cached KQL functions that cut API latency and compute load.

Launched a self-learning AI on-call engineer on Azure SRE Agent that assisted in 99.8% of resolved incidents and saved an estimated 260+ engineering hours in 4 months; it updates its troubleshooting guides from engineer feedback.

Launched a self-learning AI on-call engineer on Azure SRE Agent that assisted in 99.8% of resolved incidents and saved an estimated 260+ engineering hours in 4 months; it triages with troubleshooting guides kept as Markdown in the repo (published as docs) and updates them via PRs from engineers' feedback.
Secured APIs with OAuth 2.0: least-privilege Entra ID (Azure AD) app registrations and strict JWT validation, meeting enterprise authentication and authorization requirements.
Engineered reliable, checkpointed ingestion of 23K+ GitHub issues from 115 docs repos into Azure Data Explorer.
Engineered reliable, extensible ingestion of 23K+ GitHub issues from 115 docs repos into Azure Data Explorer (checkpointed .NET Container Apps Job, retries, OpenTelemetry alerts).

Made the platform fully infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, Azure DevOps CI/CD), ending configuration drift; added stable Playwright E2E pipelines and production-like Azure Load Testing that drove environment upgrades.
Fixed accuracy dashboards where only 142 of 278 views matched GitHub, using strict label-based product matching and a reversible, versioned data re-map.
Built the proof of concept that validated the architecture, data model, and auth before build-out; prototyped an authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.

groups.name: AI article-creation pipeline
groups.context: Python services and Azure AI Foundry agents that draft and review docs

bullets.text: Built the AI reviewer agent's validation layer: 35 deterministic, unit-tested publishing checks (metadata, structure, links) that gate every draft before approval or revision.
Automated merging of writers' edits into AI-drafted articles across an event-driven pipeline (GitHub webhooks on Azure Functions, Service Bus) with repo-allowlist and branch-prefix guardrails.
Caught two AI agent releases that served zero traffic while pipelines were green (production stayed pinned to an old version); made every deploy pin and verify the served version.
Set up Bicep IaC, CI/CD, and alerts-as-code for an Entra-authenticated MCP server on Azure Functions and for a new service that turns product change announcements into doc-update tasks.

groups.name: Content publishing platform for Microsoft Support
groups.context: Operations, release engineering, and AI automation

bullets.text: Created a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) help agent that on-call engineers use to resolve known issues.
Created a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) help agent over internal docs and troubleshooting guides that on-call engineers use to resolve known issues.
Introduced versioned release branches with rollback for three services; mitigated a top-severity outage in an hour.
Introduced versioned release branches with rollback for three services, mitigating a top-severity outage within an hour; resolved other top-severity incidents on support pages and redirects.
Diagnosed an Azure Cognitive Search indexing failure in a high-priority escalation with no prior ramp-up, unblocking a partner team's monthly reporting.
Ramped up on Azure Synapse and Scala in a month to own log and user-feed data pipelines; restored the beta environment and documented the system.

Automated release and review workflows (GitHub Copilot agents, a release-branching script, AI code-review bot skills); unblocked frontend deployments and localization by fixing builds and service accounts.

groups.name: Microsoft 365 Lighthouse
groups.context: Multi-tenant admin portal for IT service providers (MSPs) to secure customers

bullets.text: Doubled monthly users of security baselines (reusable security-policy templates, e.g., require MFA, that MSPs deploy to customers) with update badges that prompt redeploys when Microsoft revises them; adopted product-wide.
Redesigned baselines with one-click cloning of defaults, lifting cloning 80%+ and core-action completion 20%+.
Redesigned baselines with one-click cloning of Microsoft's defaults and onboarding coach marks, lifting cloning 80%+ and core-action completion 20%+ (adjusted for user growth).
Productized my hackathon prototype showing which customer tenants use each baseline and their rollout status, reaching a 5.9% click-through rate in month one.
Built Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption insights for MSPs and delivered a recommended-tasks panel after code freeze to keep a high-visibility launch on time.
Helped cut Lighthouse incidents 70%+ with a self-heal alert tier that pages on-call only past set thresholds.
Helped cut Lighthouse incidents 70%+ with a self-heal tier: noisy alerts stay notifications and page on-call only past thresholds; tuned monitors and automated incident filtering.
Created Microsoft Graph APIs backed by Azure Data Explorer for partner sales insights (renewals, license opportunities, user preferences); lifted a 7-ID filter limit and fixed pagination.
Raised test coverage with a team-wide AI instructions file for generating unit tests and Storybook stories, new UI unit tests, and stabilized Playwright E2E tests.
Fixed Lighthouse-wide issues (shared empty-state components, accessibility bugs, an infinite loading shimmer) and trimmed page URLs to essential fields for security.
Automated quarterly test-tenant onboarding (a security-compliance requirement) with AI and wrote PowerShell tools for test accounts and Graph API schema checks.
Prototyped Copilot agents bringing Lighthouse into Microsoft Teams and used Azure OpenAI function calling to automate security-baseline deployment (hackathons).
Raised the Microsoft 365 Admin Android app's update rate 60% with immediate and flexible in-app updates.
Raised the Microsoft 365 Admin Android app's update rate 60% by evaluating Xamarin and native Google Play options and building immediate and flexible in-app updates.
Fixed edge-case bugs, validated with alpha and beta testing on 10–20 devices, and presented the proof of concept, tech doc, and recommendation to the team.

leadership.text: Mentored new hires as the team doubled; led the team's Graph API design reviews; Cosmos DB expert.
Mentored and onboarded new hires as the team doubled; wrote the team's Getting Started guide and a living runbook that unblocked teammates.
Cosmos DB subject-matter expert and point of contact for the team's Microsoft Graph API design reviews; ran training sessions on Graph, Azure Data Explorer APIs, and AI tools.
Go-to engineer for product managers' data analysis; proactively cleared pending incidents and updated troubleshooting guides beyond my ownership.

awards.text: Winner, Harden the Core Franchise category (Data Platform Growth org), Microsoft Global Hackathon 2026: Code to Content, agentic AI that updates docs as products change, so users and AI agents get accurate answers.

Best Hack, Live Site & Automation category (Data Platform Growth org), Microsoft Hackathon 2025: an AI agent that triages and resolves production incidents through multiple MCP servers; later piloted internally.
